ai_summary: Aartech Solonics Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary, Faradigm Ultracapacitors, has signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with China's Shenzhen Titan Smart Energy Technology to explore strategic cooperation in advanced LFP-based energy storage solutions and localized manufacturing in India. This collaboration aims to capitalize on India's rapidly growing commercial and industrial energy storage market, leveraging Faradigm's planned manufacturing facility to be operational by FY 2027-28. However, the exploratory nature of the MoU means definitive agreements and the full realization of these ambitious strategic goals remain uncertain.
